annotations.title: Read what a workspace tracks today

description: Read the workspace's canonical tracked-item total and breakdown: one item per search in one market on one platform, hashtag or account, counted once however many groups include it, with paused items separate. Use this total whenever you state how many searches, hashtags or accounts are tracked; do not add up group item counts or count a page of list results. Pass includeItems for a page of items, including paused items, with platform, market, frequency, last and next collection, latest refresh outcome and Monitor report inclusion. The summary always covers the whole workspace. To read every item, repeat with offset=pagination.nextOffset while pagination.hasMore is true. Reads stored evidence/configuration; no provider collection or collection charge. Preserve returned timestamps, coverage, missing evidence and errors. Synchronous; no polling unless the result explicitly supplies continuation.

limit.description: Items per page when includeItems=true; defaults to 20, maximum 100.

offset.description: Zero-based item offset; defaults to 0. Use pagination.nextOffset to continue.

workspaceId.description: Reuse the authorized default or sole accessible workspace when omitted.
